subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification / AvaTech - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Zhao <samir.zhao@avatech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity follow-up: AvaTech discovery recap

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the specific inputs we need to put together a Dedicated capacity proposal that fits AvaTech's throughput and budget goals.

Call highlights:
- Primary workload: realtime summarization + customer-facing chat (generation-heavy).
- Target latency: p95 < 250ms for 8k-context summaries, < 150ms for short chat turns.
- Current prod QPS equivalent: ~120 concurrent requests during spikes.
- Growth expectation: ~3-4x over next 12 months.

What we need from you to finalize sizing & pricing:
1) Expected monthly token volumes (prompt vs completion if possible).
2) Target budget range (monthly committed or annual).
3) Target unit economics — e.g. target $/1M tokens (ballpark is fine).
4) Any hard constraints on GPU type (A100-80GB vs H100) or preference for reserved vs burstable.
5) Latency SLOs and any compliance/retention requirements we should bake into the contract.

Prelim thinking from our side (based on today's call):
- Model family: 7–13B class quantized model with KV cache (we’ll propose a verified open model or bring-your-own-model option).
- Starting pool: 4x A100-80GB dedicated to start (offers good cost/perf balance for 8k contexts).
- Option to SKU to 2x H100 for higher throughput (30–50% lower token latency for heavy parallel generation).

I attached a short sizing workbook (initial-sizing-avatech.xlsx) with a couple of scenarios. If you can confirm 1–4 above this week, I’ll send a formal pricing sheet and recommend the exact reserved capacity and expected $/1M tokens.

Next steps:
- You: send estimated monthly token volumes + target $/1M tokens (if you have a procurement target).
- Us: deliver preliminary pricing + PO/contract timeline by Wed next week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Samir Zhao <samir.zhao@avatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: AvaTech discovery recap

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications / numbers from our side:

1) Monthly token volume (current / 6-mo expected / 12-mo expected):
- Current run-rate: ~1.5B tokens/month (prompt+completion combined).
- 6-mo expected: 3.2B/month.
- 12-mo expected: 5.8B/month (aggressive product expansion).

2) Breakdown (rough): ~30% prompt tokens, ~70% completion tokens (avg completion length ~220 tokens).

3) Budget range: We're targeting committed spend of $40k–$80k/month initially, with flexibility to expand if unit economics are favorable.

4) Unit economics target: we'd like to get to roughly $300–$350 per 1M tokens (net after any caching/batching benefits). If that's unrealistic, tell us where Redwood sees realistic savings with Dedicated.

5) GPU preference: Our infra team prefers A100-80GB for compatibility but we're open to H100 if you can show clear perf + unit-econ benefits.

6) Throughput / latency: Need to support ~200 concurrent sessions in peak bursts; p95 latency target: summaries < 250ms.

7) Procurement: procurement@avatech.com will be the signing org — include them on the next pricing doc.

We'll review the sizing workbook and get back with any adjustments. Thanks — Samir

--
Samir Zhao
VP Product 
AvaTech
samir.zhao@avatech.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Zhao <samir.zhao@avatech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@avatech.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: AvaTech discovery recap

Thanks Samir — this is super helpful. Below is a concise sizing + preliminary pricing summary based on your numbers and our typical unit-econ assumptions.

Sizing recommendation (prelim):
- Initial Dedicated pool: 4x NVIDIA A100-80GB (reserved)
  - Rationale: cost-efficient for up to ~3B tokens/month with the model and batching assumptions below.
  - Expected steady throughput: ~150–250 concurrent short/chat sessions (depends on batch profile).
- Upgrade path: add 2x H100 or swap pool to 2x H100 for sustained >4–5B tokens/month to improve latency and parallel throughput.

Assumptions for unit economics:
- Avg generation length: 220 tokens
- Avg prompt tokens per request: 80 tokens
- Batching factor: 12–16 (continuous batching for non-strict real-time flows)
- KV cache hit: 10–20% (prefix reuse for summarization tasks)
- Model: quantized 13B-class open model we verify for production (can also support your private weights).

Prelim unit-econ (estimates):
- With 4x A100 and the assumptions above, estimated delivered cost to AvaTech: ~$295 per 1M tokens.
- If you commit to a 12-month reserved pool and strict reserved capacity sizing (4x A100), we can push to ~$250–$275 per 1M tokens via deeper discounts and cross-customer kernel optimizations.
- Moving to 2x H100 for sustained >4B tokens/month reduces latency; expected effective $/1M tokens moves higher on raw infra but lower on ops overhead for heavy concurrency — net $/1M depends on commitment term.

Notes / open items:
- These numbers exclude data-transfer and optional observability add-ons (we'll call those out separately).
- We flagged a procurement-friendly contract template for your legal team — will include in the formal bundle.

Attached: prelim-pricing-avatech.xlsx and dedicated-pricing-2026.pdf (first-pass). I'll also add a proposal row in HubSpot (AVT-2026-003).

Next suggested steps:
1) Procurement call to align on PO/term and any compliance needs (requested attendees: Samir, procurement@avatech.com, Marcus, myself).
2) If you want, we can schedule a 2-week PoC (restricted capacity) to validate latency and throughput with your traffic shape.

If that looks reasonable, I’ll draft the formal proposal and pricing SLA for review.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Samir Zhao <samir.zhao@avatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@avatech.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up: AvaTech discovery recap

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the transparency on assumptions — the numbers look in-line with what procurement expects.

We'd like to:
- Schedule the procurement/terms call next Tue (30 Mar) at 10am PT.
- Proceed with a 2-week PoC on 4x A100 to validate latency under our real traffic (we'll provide a synthetic traffic generator).
- Target starting reserved pool in June if PoC meets SLOs; procurement will start paperwork contingent on the final pricing doc.

Can you share the formal pricing doc + PO template ahead of the call? procurement@avatech.com will be on the thread.

Thanks — Samir
